title: Full Admin Server Control — Backend Endpoints & Admin Dashboard

requirements.text: Extend the backend actor to expose an admin-only function `setUserRole(userId: Principal, role: {#admin; #teacher; #student}) : async Result` that allows an admin to change any user's assigned role. Guard the call so only a principal with the #admin role can invoke it.

quotes: complete control over the server as administrator

acceptanceCriteria: A non-admin caller receives an #err("Unauthorized") result.
An admin caller successfully updates the target user's role and the change is reflected in subsequent profile queries.
The function is accessible from the frontend admin dashboard.

requirements.text: Extend the backend actor to expose an admin-only function `deleteUser(userId: Principal) : async Result` that permanently removes a user profile, all associated bookings, activity logs, performance metrics, and review records from stable storage.

quotes: complete control over the server as administrator

acceptanceCriteria: Only a principal with the #admin role can invoke this function; all other callers receive an #err("Unauthorized") result.
After deletion, querying the removed user's profile returns a null/not-found result.
All linked bookings, logs, metrics, and reviews for the deleted user are also removed.

requirements.text: Extend the backend actor to expose admin-only functions for booking management: `adminUpdateBookingStatus(bookingId: Text, status: BookingStatus) : async Result` to force-update any booking's status, and `adminDeleteBooking(bookingId: Text) : async Result` to permanently remove a booking record.

quotes: complete control over the server as administrator

acceptanceCriteria: Only admin principals can call these functions.
adminUpdateBookingStatus correctly transitions a booking to any valid status (pending, confirmed, completed, cancelled).
adminDeleteBooking removes the booking from stable storage and it no longer appears in any query results.

requirements.text: Extend the backend actor to expose admin-only content moderation functions: `deleteReview(reviewId: Text) : async Result` to remove any review, and `deleteMessage(messageId: Text) : async Result` to remove any message from any conversation thread.

quotes: complete control over the server as administrator

acceptanceCriteria: Only admin principals can call these functions.
Deleted reviews no longer appear on the teacher's profile page.
Deleted messages no longer appear in the conversation thread for either participant.

requirements.text: Extend the backend actor to expose admin-only system configuration functions: `setStripeConfig(secretKey: Text, allowedCountries: [Text]) : async Result` (already partially exists — ensure it is admin-gated), `setPlatformCommissionRate(rateBps: Nat) : async Result` to update the platform commission percentage stored in stable state, and `getPlatformConfig() : async PlatformConfig` to retrieve current configuration values.

quotes: complete control over the server as administrator

acceptanceCriteria: All mutating config functions reject non-admin callers.
setPlatformCommissionRate updates the rate used in future payment calculations.
getPlatformConfig returns the current Stripe config and commission rate to admin callers only.

requirements.text: Extend the backend actor to expose admin-only withdrawal management functions: `approveWithdrawal(withdrawalId: Text) : async Result` and `rejectWithdrawal(withdrawalId: Text, reason: Text) : async Result` that update the withdrawal request status in stable storage and adjust the teacher's wallet balance accordingly on approval.

quotes: complete control over the server as administrator

acceptanceCriteria: Only admin principals can call these functions.
Approving a withdrawal sets its status to 'approved' and deducts the amount from the teacher's wallet balance.
Rejecting a withdrawal sets its status to 'rejected' with the provided reason, leaving the wallet balance unchanged.

requirements.text: Add a 'System Configuration' tab to the AdminDashboard frontend page. This tab must display and allow editing of: (1) Platform commission rate (shown as a percentage, editable via a number input with a Save button that calls `setPlatformCommissionRate`); (2) Stripe configuration (secret key masked input and allowed-countries multi-select, saving via the existing StripeSetupModal or an inline form); (3) A 'Danger Zone' section containing a clearly styled 'Delete User' action available from the User Management tab's row actions.

quotes: complete control over the server as administrator

acceptanceCriteria: The System Configuration tab is visible only when the logged-in user has the admin role.
Saving a new commission rate calls the backend and shows a success/error toast.
Stripe config fields are pre-populated with current values from `getPlatformConfig`.
The Danger Zone delete action shows a confirmation dialog before calling `deleteUser`.

requirements.text: Extend the existing AdminDashboard User Management tab to include row-level admin actions for each user: a 'Change Role' dropdown (admin/teacher/student) that calls `setUserRole`, and a 'Delete User' button that opens a confirmation dialog before calling `deleteUser`. Both actions must be disabled in demo mode.

quotes: complete control over the server as administrator

acceptanceCriteria: The Change Role dropdown correctly reflects the user's current role and updates it on selection.
The Delete User button shows a modal asking 'Are you sure? This cannot be undone.' before proceeding.
Both actions display a success or error toast after completion.
In demo mode, both controls are visually disabled with a tooltip 'Not available in demo mode'.

requirements.text: Extend the existing AdminDashboard Bookings tab to include admin override actions per booking row: a status override dropdown (pending/confirmed/completed/cancelled) that calls `adminUpdateBookingStatus`, and a 'Delete Booking' button that calls `adminDeleteBooking` after confirmation. Both actions must be disabled in demo mode.

quotes: complete control over the server as administrator

acceptanceCriteria: The status override dropdown reflects the booking's current status and updates it on change.
The Delete Booking button shows a confirmation dialog before proceeding.
Success and error states are communicated via toast notifications.
In demo mode, controls show a 'Not available in demo mode' tooltip and are non-interactive.

requirements.text: Add a 'Content Moderation' tab to the AdminDashboard that lists all reviews and all messages platform-wide (fetched via admin-only backend queries). Each review row must include a 'Delete Review' button calling `deleteReview`. Each message row must include a 'Delete Message' button calling `deleteMessage`. Both must show a confirmation dialog and display success/error toasts. The tab must be disabled in demo mode.

quotes: complete control over the server as administrator

acceptanceCriteria: The Content Moderation tab lists all reviews with teacher name, student name, rating, text, and a Delete button.
The tab lists all messages with sender, recipient, timestamp, message preview, and a Delete button.
Deleting a review removes it from the list and from the teacher's public profile immediately (or on next fetch).
Deleting a message removes it from the list immediately.
In demo mode, the tab is visible but delete buttons are disabled.

requirements.text: Extend the existing AdminDashboard Withdrawals tab to include 'Approve' and 'Reject' action buttons for each pending withdrawal request, calling `approveWithdrawal` and `rejectWithdrawal` respectively. The Reject action must prompt the admin for a rejection reason before submitting. Both actions must be disabled in demo mode.

quotes: complete control over the server as administrator

acceptanceCriteria: Pending withdrawal rows show both 'Approve' and 'Reject' buttons; already processed rows show the final status badge only.
Clicking 'Reject' opens a small textarea modal to enter a reason before confirming.
Successful approval or rejection updates the row status in the UI immediately.
In demo mode, both buttons are disabled with a 'Not available in demo mode' tooltip.

constraints: All new backend functions that mutate or read sensitive data must enforce admin-role authorization and return an #err("Unauthorized") result for non-admin callers.
Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Demo mode must never allow destructive backend calls; all destructive UI controls must be visually disabled in demo mode.
nonGoals: Adding new user-facing student or teacher features.
Changing the existing payment flow or Stripe integration.
Building a separate admin microservice or external admin panel — all controls remain within the existing single-actor backend and AdminDashboard frontend page.
